prompt: Who was the oldest Miss Universe titleholder at the time of her crowning, cheered as a triumph over ageism in a youth-obsessed world?
answer: It was **Alejandra Marisa Rodríguez of Argentina**, who at age 60 was crowned **Miss Universe Buenos Aires**—making headlines as the pageant’s oldest contestant and a symbol against ageism. She did not go on to win the national Miss Argentina title or the global Miss Universe crown.
